title: Place value
examples: Teacher, what is the value of the seven in 725?
How do I write the number four hundred and sixty thousand?
Why do we need a zero in the number 503?

explain.say: Place value tells you what a digit is worth. It depends on the place where the digit is.
Look at the blocks. A small yellow cube is one. A green stick is ten cubes, so it is one ten. Tap a block to hear about it.
Ten ones make one ten. You can swap ten small cubes for one stick.
Look at the number twenty-three. The two is in the tens place. It means two tens, so it is worth twenty. The three is in the ones place.
A zero holds an empty place. In forty, the zero shows the ones place is empty. So forty is four tens.
Ten tens make one hundred. You write one hundred as a one and two zeros.

faq.q: What does the zero do in a number?
faq.a: The zero acts like a placeholder. It shows that a certain place value, like tens or hundreds, is empty. It keeps the value of other digits correct.
asks: Why do we use zero in numbers?
What is the job of zero in place value?

faq.q: How do I write one hundred?
faq.a: You write a one and then two zeros: 100. It means one hundred, zero tens and zero ones.
asks: What is the number five million?
How many zeros are in five million?

faq.q: If I see a number like 60, what is the zero doing?
faq.a: The zero is in the ones place. It shows there are zero ones. So 60 is six tens.
asks: What does the zero mean in 409?

faq.q: Can I just say the number without using place value names?
faq.a: You can say it in words, but understanding place value helps you know the actual value. It helps you compare and add bigger numbers.
asks: Should I learn place value or just count?
Is place value just for writing numbers?

faq.q: What is the biggest place value we learned?
faq.a: In this lesson the biggest place is the hundreds. Ten tens make one hundred.
asks: What is the highest place value?

facts: The place values go up: ones, tens, hundreds, thousands, millions.
A zero is used when a place value is empty, like in 702.
The digit in the millions place represents millions of items.
Partitioning means breaking a number into its place value parts.

quiz.say: Look at the number. Tap what the 4 is worth.
quiz.why: The 4 is in the tens place. It means 4 tens, which is 40.

wrong.0: The digit is 4, but it sits in the tens place, so it is worth more.
wrong.1: The number 47 is the whole number, and the 4 is just one part of it.

quiz.say: Tap the tens and ones that make this number.
quiz.why: The 6 is in the tens place and the 5 is in the ones place. So 65 is 6 tens and 5 ones.

wrong.1: Five tens and six ones make 56, so the digits are swapped.
wrong.2: Sixty tens would be 600, but the 6 in 65 means 6 tens.

quiz.say: Read the card. Tap the number it makes.
quiz.why: 3 tens is 30. The zero shows that there are zero ones.

wrong.0: The number 3 is 3 ones, but the card has 3 tens.
wrong.2: The number 300 is 3 hundreds, but the card has 3 tens.
